prompt:
You are a UI/UX coding agent. Build a complete, responsive landing page as a multi-section marketing site using a CSS-first architecture. The visual style is "Say Briefly" — a creative agency sketchbook aesthetic on warm cream paper. You must invent a fictional brand name, product, and all user-facing copy. Never use the real brand name "SayBriefly", its logo, trademarks, or product names anywhere in the page. All copy must be written in English.

## 1. File Structure & Architecture
- Deliver three separate files: `index.html`, `style.css`, `script.js`. No inline `<script>` blocks beyond a single deferred entry-point reference. No inline `style="..."` attributes anywhere in the HTML.
- All styling lives strictly in `style.css` using class/ID selectors only. HTML must remain clean, semantic, and agnostic of visual styling.
- Use Tailwind CSS (or clean custom CSS driven by Tailwind's `@layer`/`@apply` directives). All utility classes must map back to CSS variables or generic reusable class names (`.btn`, `.card`, `.input-group`).
- Enforce one consistent class-naming convention (BEM) across the entire deliverable. Never mix conventions.
- No lorem-ipsum-only submissions; write real, plausible English marketing copy for every section.

## 2. CSS Variables & Theme Tokens
Store all visual tokens inside `:root` (and theme classes) using CSS variables. Mandatory tokens:

Colors (light theme, cream paper mood — do not default to pure white; use `#fcfaf5` for canvas):
- `--color-forest-ink: #1a3300` (primary text, filled CTA buttons, link text, nav borders, card borders — carries 90% of interface weight)
- `--color-highlighter-yellow: #ffe95c` (text highlight wash behind keywords in headlines, badge backgrounds, accent fills — reads as marker stroke, never as CTA)
- `--color-cream-paper: #fcfaf5` (page canvas, card surfaces, nav background — warm off-white, slightly yellow-shifted)
- `--color-pencil-gray: #b6b6b6` (nav and divider borders — single mid-gray for hairlines)
- `--color-whisper-gray: #f1f1f1` (muted helper text, secondary labels)
- `--color-sticky-note-teal: #a8e5e5` (teal action color for filled buttons, selected nav states, focused conversion moments)
- `--color-sticky-note-mint: #d5f5c2` (green action color for filled buttons, selected nav states)
- `--color-sticky-note-blush: #f6d0ff` (decorative button/card fill — sprinkle use only)
- `--color-terracotta: #cb5521` (decorative card accent — warm counterpoint)

Standard architecture tokens (map to the above palette):
- `--primary: var(--color-forest-ink)`
- `--secondary: var(--color-cream-paper)`
- `--bg-primary: var(--color-cream-paper)`
- `--bg-secondary: var(--color-cream-paper)`
- `--text-primary: var(--color-forest-ink)`
- `--text-secondary: var(--color-whisper-gray)`
- `--text-success: var(--color-sticky-note-mint)`
- `--text-error: var(--color-terracotta)`
- `--border-default: var(--color-pencil-gray)`
- `--border-error: var(--color-terracotta)`
- `--border-success: var(--color-sticky-note-mint)`

Contrast pairing: every light background token pairs with a dark text token; every dark background token pairs with a light text token. Enforce this pairing in every theme, including dark mode.

Border radius & shadows:
- `--radius-sm: 6px` (buttons)
- `--radius-md: 12px` (cards)
- `--radius-lg: 16px` (nav container)
- `--shadow-sm: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.05) 0px 1px 2px 0px` (primary CTA)
- `--shadow-md: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.1) 0px 1px 3px 0px, rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.1) 0px 1px 2px -1px` (secondary button hover/active)
- `--shadow-xl: rgba(255, 235, 90, 0.01) 0px 527px 211px 0px, ...` (nav glow — multi-layer yellow shadow bleeding beyond nav edges)

Spacing & transitions:
- `--spacing-gap: 16px`
- `--transition-fast: 150ms ease`
- `--transition-normal: 250ms ease`
- `--ease-standard: cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1)`
- `--z-dropdown: 10`, `--z-modal: 100`, `--z-toast: 200`

Typography:
- `--font-base: 'Inter', system-ui, -apple-system, Segoe UI, sans-serif`
- `--font-display: 'Bricolage Grotesque', 'Archivo Black', 'Mulish', sans-serif` (display headlines only, 800 weight, positive tracking)
- `--font-mono: 'Roboto Mono', 'JetBrains Mono', 'IBM Plex Mono', monospace` (micro-labels, tags, technical metadata)

Font sizes (type scale tokens):
- `--text-micro: 11px` (line-height 1.3)
- `--text-caption: 14px` (line-height 1.5)
- `--text-body-sm: 16px` (line-height 1.5)
- `--text-body: 18px` (line-height 1.5)
- `--text-body-lg: 20px` (line-height 1.38)
- `--text-subheading: 28px` (line-height 1.25)
- `--text-heading-sm: 40px` (line-height 1.1)
- `--text-heading: 55px` (line-height 1.0, letter-spacing 2.2px)
- `--text-heading-lg: 66px` (line-height 1.0, letter-spacing 3.3px)
- `--text-display: 90px` (line-height 1.0, letter-spacing 4.5px)

Spacing scale: 8, 16, 24, 32, 40, 48, 56, 64, 80, 96, 120 (px). Base unit 8px, comfortable density.

Page max-width: 1200px. Section gap: 64px. Card padding: 24px. Element gap: 16px.

## 3. Mandatory Dark Mode
- Provide dark mode color tokens under `@media (prefers-color-scheme: dark)` and/or a `.dark` class selector. Background and text CSS variables must switch seamlessly without HTML restructuring.
- In dark mode, invert the cream/forest relationship: a dark forest-tinted background with light cream text, preserving the same structural roles. Maintain contrast pairing for every token.
- Persist user theme choice via `localStorage`, falling back to `prefers-color-scheme` on first visit. Provide a visible toggle control with correct `aria-pressed`/`aria-label` state.
- Never rely solely on color to communicate state in either theme.

## 4. Typography & Icons
- Include Google Fonts `<link>` tags for: Bricolage Grotesque (800), Inter (300, 400, 500, 600, 700), Roboto Mono (400). Bind to `--font-display`, `--font-base`, `--font-mono`.
- Use Google Material Symbols/Icons for all icons. Explicitly forbid raw inline SVGs or local icon files.

## 5. Layout & Flexbox Rules
- Build all layout structures using Flexbox (`display: flex`). Every flex container must default to `align-items: center` unless there is an explicitly justified exception.
- Mobile-first: all flex layouts must be mobile-responsive out of the box (rows convert to columns on smaller viewports). Prevent horizontal scrolling.
- Page layout: max-width 1200px centered, generous side padding. Hero is a single centered column. Sections stack vertically without alternating dark/light bands — cream canvas consistent throughout. Feature sections transition to 2-column and 3-column card grids. Navigation sits in a floating pill-shaped container centered at the top. Section gaps 64-80px; cards never crowd.

## 6. Component Specifications

### Button Component
- Default: flex layout (`display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 0.5rem`), minimum touch target 44x44px.
- Hover: visual shift (brightness/shadow) with `cursor: pointer`.
- Focus: distinct focus ring using CSS variables (`outline`/`box-shadow`) for keyboard navigation.
- Active/Pressed: click transform feedback (`transform: scale(0.97)`).
- Loading: disables interactions, prevents double-clicks, renders CSS spinner or animated Google Icon without distorting button dimensions.
- Disabled: reduced opacity (0.5), greyscale, `cursor: not-allowed`.
- Success/Error: temporary feedback state styles driven by `--text-success`/`--text-error`.

Button variants for this theme:
- Primary CTA: filled Forest Ink (`#1a3300`) background, Cream Paper (`#fcfaf5`) text, 6px radius, padding 19px 40px (or 12px 20px compact). Inter 500 at 16px. Subtle shadow `--shadow-sm`. Contains inline arrow glyph (→) before label.
- Outline Nav Button: transparent fill, 1px Forest Ink border, 6px radius, padding 8px 16px. Inter 500 at 14px in Forest Ink. Used for "Log In" in nav.
- Pastel Accent Button: filled with one of the sticky-note pastels (Blush, Teal, Mint), Forest Ink text at 14-16px Inter 500, 6px radius. Used for demo/secondary paths.

### Card Component
- Default: flexible flexbox layout, styled with subtle borders and elevation using `--bg-secondary` and CSS variables.
- Hover: elevation/shadow shift or subtle transform (`transform: translateY(-2px)`).
- Focus-within: highlights card borders when a child link/button receives focus.
- Loading (Skeleton): shimmer animation styling defined in CSS to prevent layout jumps.
- Empty State: structured fallback layout featuring a Google Icon and clear guidance text.

Sticky Note Card variant: 12-16px radius, 24-28px padding, filled with one of the pastel accents (Mint, Blush, Teal, Terracotta) or Cream Paper. Forest Ink text. Optional 1px Forest Ink border. No shadow — the color fill does the separation work.

### Form & Input
- States: Empty, Focused (outline ring), Filled, Valid (success border/icon), Invalid (error border, red text, error icon), Disabled, Read-only.
- Structure: flex container wrapping a label, input field, and dedicated error feedback container.

### Modal / Popup
- States: Opening, Open, Loading, Success/Error, Closing (all animated via CSS transitions).
- UX: centered flex container (`align-items: center`), backdrop overlay, Google Icon close button, keyboard focus trapping, support for closing via Esc or overlay clicks.

## 7. Global UX & Micro-Interaction Rules
- Responsive by default: fluid sizing and responsive breakpoints without horizontal overflow.
- Smooth animations: CSS transitions on all state changes (`transition: var(--transition-normal)`), respecting `prefers-reduced-motion`.
- Accessibility: sufficient contrast in both light and dark modes. Never rely solely on color to communicate state. Semantic HTML5 elements, correct ARIA roles/labels on custom widgets, logical DOM/focus order, full keyboard operability (no mouse-only interactions), `aria-live` regions for dynamic feedback (form errors, toasts, loading states).
- Mandatory visual feedback: every user click, hover, or submission must trigger a visible state change.
- Destructive actions: generic `.btn-danger` or delete actions must be visually distinct in both light and dark themes.

## 8. Landing Page Sections to Build
Build all of the following sections with real English marketing copy for the fictional brand:

1. **Top Navigation Bar**: floating pill-shaped container, centered at top, 16px radius, 1px Pencil Gray border, Cream Paper background. Logo left (40x40 Highlighter Yellow square with hand-drawn 'lo' monogram in Forest Ink + 'BrandName' wordmark in Inter 700 at 20px Forest Ink). Center: nav links (Inter 500, 14px, Forest Ink). Right: outline nav button ("Log In") + filled primary CTA. Contains the multi-layer yellow shadow glow bleeding beyond nav edges. Theme toggle control included.

2. **Hero Section**: single centered column. Tagline badge (small pill, Highlighter Yellow background, Forest Ink text 12-14px Inter 500, with lightbulb/star icon) centered above headline. Display hero headline: Bricolage Grotesque 800 at 66-90px, Forest Ink, line-height 1.0, letter-spacing 0.04-0.05em. One or two words within the headline get the Highlighter Yellow background wash (rectangular marker behind text, not a border). Subhead paragraph: Inter 400 at 18-20px, Forest Ink, line-height 1.5, max-width ~600px, centered. Primary CTA button stack. Reassurance caption below CTA ("no credit card required." in Whisper/Pencil Gray, 12-14px). Decorative sketch elements (hand-drawn line illustrations in Forest Ink at ~30% opacity) as background atmosphere.

3. **Backed-By Logo Strip**: horizontal row of partner/funder logos in muted gray, preceded by "Backed by:" label (Inter 400 12px). Logos at uniform 16-20px height. Appears below primary CTAs.

4. **Features Section**: 3 sticky-note cards in a grid. Each card: 12-16px radius, 24-28px padding, filled with one pastel accent (Mint, Blush, Teal — one per card, never two same pastels adjacent), Forest Ink text, optional 1px Forest Ink border, no shadow. Heading: Inter 600 at 24px. Body: Inter 400 at 16px, line-height 1.5. Each card has a Google Material Icon.

5. **How It Works Section**: 3 steps. Each step: number badge, heading (Inter 600/700), description (Inter 400 16-18px). Layout as horizontal row on desktop, vertical stack on mobile.

6. **Testimonials Section**: 2-3 testimonial cards. Sticky-note card style. Quote text (Inter 400 16-18px), author name (Inter 600), role/company (Inter 400 14px muted). Avatar placeholder using Google Material Icon or initial.

7. **Pricing Section**: 3 pricing tiers. Each tier as a card. Highlight one tier as recommended (Highlighter Yellow accent or Forest Ink fill). Include plan name, price, feature list with check icons, CTA button. Pastel accent buttons for secondary tiers, primary CTA for recommended.

8. **FAQ Section**: accordion-style. Each item: question (Inter 600 16-18px) with expand/collapse, answer (Inter 400 16px). Use CSS transitions for open/close. Keyboard accessible.

9. **Final CTA Section**: centered. Display headline (Bricolage Grotesque), subhead, primary CTA button, reassurance caption. Cream canvas with decorative sketch elements.

10. **Footer**: secondary links in columns. Brand logo, nav links, legal links, social icons (Google Material Symbols). Cream Paper background with 1px Pencil Gray top border.

## 9. Style Rules (Do's and Don'ts)
Do:
- Use Forest Ink (`#1a3300`) for all primary text, links, and CTA buttons — the single chromatic workhorse.
- Set display headlines in Bricolage Grotesque 800 with positive letter-spacing (0.04-0.05em); let it breathe at line-height 1.0.
- Apply Highlighter Yellow (`#ffe95c`) as a background wash behind individual words in headlines, not as a button fill or full surface.
- Use 6px radius for all buttons and 12-16px for cards — never mix sharp 0px corners with the rounded system.
- Set body copy at 18-20px Inter 400 with 1.5 line-height.
- Separate layers with color fills and 1px borders, not shadows. Shadows reserved for nav glow and button lift only.
- Keep the page 95% cream + forest green. Pastel accents (Mint, Blush, Teal) appear as individual card or button fills, never as large surfaces.
- Never combine multiple pastel accent cards in the same row without cream space between them.

Don't:
- Don't use Bricolage Grotesque for body text, nav, buttons, or anything below 40px.
- Don't introduce a second primary brand color. Forest Ink is the only chromatic authority.
- Don't apply heavy drop shadows. Box-shadows above 2px blur break the flat aesthetic.
- Don't use pure black (`#000000`) for text. Forest Ink is the text color; pure black only as SVG fill/stroke in decorative elements.
- Don't center-align body paragraphs wider than 640px. Headlines and subheads center, but reading copy left-aligned or constrained.
- Don't use Highlighter Yellow as a CTA background. It reads as a marker, not an action.
- Don't combine multiple pastel accent cards in the same row.

## 10. Imagery
Imagery is minimal and hand-crafted. Use black-line sketch illustrations at reduced opacity (~30%) as atmospheric background elements — abstract shapes, partial drawings, gestural marks. No product photography, no stock imagery, no 3D renders. Decorative elements are monoline (1-2px stroke), unfilled, deliberately imperfect. Iconography is small and functional, appearing in tagline badge and form contexts. Overall image density is low — text-dominant with illustration as texture.

## 11. Deliverable Notes
- File structure: separate `index.html`, `style.css`, `script.js`. No inline `<script>` beyond a single deferred entry-point reference.
- Naming: BEM convention throughout. Never mix conventions.
- No unrequested placeholders: write real English copy for all sections. Placeholders only where content was genuinely left unspecified.
- Respect `prefers-reduced-motion` for all animations.
- Ensure full keyboard operability and ARIA correctness across all interactive components (nav, buttons, accordion, modal, theme toggle).

Output only the finished code files. No preamble, no closing commentary.
